page.content:
Andrew was a wizard and Ravenclaw student at Hogwarts School during the 1990s. In 1992, he became a member of the Duelling Club and was ranked fourth on the Club's top-ten duellists list.

Who is Andrew?

Andrew was a man who lived during the 19th century. He owned a periodical paper, along with their partner G. Paul, which was based out of Great St. in Bloomsbury, London.
